name: Input Styling
description: Restyle Safelight's controls. Pick a preset (Safelight, Classic, Precise, Soft), then tweak any aspect: square, rounded or pill corners; round, square, pointed or line slider knobs and their size; track thickness; drawn checkboxes; numeric fields that grow while you type. Or write your own CSS against the app's styling hooks.
author: Anthony Reimche <anthonyreimche@gmail.com>
